user.title: Add a PC
user.description: Set up a computer that Home Assistant can wake over the LAN and power off. The pc_onoff daemon must be running on the target PC for shutdown, reboot, sleep, hibernate and lock.

data_description.name: Friendly name for this PC. Google Home uses it for voice commands, for example: Hey Google, turn on Gaming PC.
data_description.mac: MAC address of the wired network adapter that receives the Wake-on-LAN magic packet.
data_description.host: LAN, Tailscale or public IP address of the PC. The pc_onoff daemon listens on UDP 9877.
data_description.udp_port: UDP port of the pc_onoff daemon. Default: 9877.
data_description.wol_port: UDP port for the magic packet. Default: 9.
data_description.broadcast_ip: IPv4 broadcast address for the magic packet. Use 255.255.255.255 or a subnet broadcast such as 192.168.1.255.
data_description.pc_secret: Optional on the LAN and Tailscale; required only for a public IP address. Copy it from pc_onoff --status (Command Secret). It is stored in the config entry and never logged.
data_description.off_action: Action used when the switch is turned off. Shutdown is the default; sleep and hibernate keep the session.
data_description.probe_mode: How to detect whether the PC is on. Ping needs an IP that answers ICMP, TCP checks only a port, and none assumes the last requested state.
data_description.probe_port: TCP port checked in TCP probe mode. Default: 445 (SMB).
data_description.scan_interval: Seconds between status checks (5-3600). Default: 30. Not used when the probe mode is none.

error.invalid_mac: Invalid MAC address. Use the format AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.
error.invalid_host: Enter a valid unicast IPv4 or IPv6 address. Broadcast, multicast and unspecified addresses are not allowed.
error.invalid_broadcast_ip: Enter a valid IPv4 broadcast address.
error.invalid_port: Port must be a whole number between 1 and 65535.
error.invalid_scan_interval: Scan interval must be a whole number between 5 and 3600 seconds.
error.secret_required_for_public_ip: A public IP address requires the PC secret. Use the LAN or Tailscale instead, or copy the secret from pc_onoff --status.
error.invalid_secret: The PC secret contains control characters. Paste it again without line breaks.

init.title: PC settings
init.description: Update the network and power settings for this PC. The name and MAC address stay fixed so entity IDs and Google Home voice commands keep working.
